ai_notes: [Wooden pelican mobile decoration] Niche home decor items are difficult to sell and often sit for a long time.

title: Handcrafted Leather Backpack with Elephant and Animal Print Design
description: Colorful leather backpack featuring intricate elephant, giraffe, and palm tree motifs in vibrant reds, oranges, and greens. Features black leather trim, brass buckle closure, adjustable straps, and multiple compartments. Handmade craftsmanship with detailed animal patterns throughout.
ai_notes: [Handcrafted leather animal print backpack] Artisan-style bags have a limited buyer pool compared to major fashion brands.

title: Madison West Tan Leather Satchel Handbag with Shoulder Strap
description: Structured tan leather handbag featuring dual top handles, detachable shoulder strap, zip closure, and multiple interior compartments with Madison West branding. Cross-hatched leather texture with contrasting stitching details.
ai_notes: [Madison West tan leather satchel] Madison West is a budget-friendly mall brand; resale value is modest.

title: Green Leather Bifold Wallet with Card Slots
description: Green leather bifold wallet featuring multiple card slots, ID window, bill compartments, and metal clasp closure with detailed stitching throughout
ai_notes: [Green leather bifold wallet] Generic leather wallets without a luxury brand name are difficult to move for significant value.

title: Dressbarn Women's Geometric Print Long Sleeve Blouse
description: Navy blue and yellow geometric patterned long sleeve blouse with V-neck design. Features all-over diamond and dot print pattern. Made from lightweight fabric suitable for casual or professional wear.
ai_notes: [Dressbarn geometric print blouse] Used mall-brand clothing has very low resale value and is slow to sell.

title: White Cotton Twill Pants with Elastic Waist
description: White cotton twill pants featuring elastic waistband with ribbed cuffs. Sears Exceptional Value brand casual pants suitable for everyday wear.
ai_notes: [Sears Exceptional Value cotton pants] Generic, budget-brand used clothing is rarely worth the effort to list.
